seo.title: Nate Winter · Designer & Art Director · 3D Product Visualization & Motion
seo.description: Nate Winter is a Milwaukee designer and art director specializing in 3D product visualization, motion, packaging, and brand work for product-led brands across CPG, supplements, beverage, beauty, and wellness.

hero.subtext:
Helping brands build the visual world around their products, shaping everything from identity and packaging to the visuals that bring them into motion.

Whether a brand is launching something new or refining what it already has, the work is built to make the product impossible to overlook.

work.title:
Made for clients,
*and for the craft.*

steps.label: Direction
steps.body: We define the purpose, audience, tone, and visual direction before anything gets made. This creates a clear foundation for the work and makes sure every decision has a reason behind it.

steps.label: Development
steps.body: I turn that direction into visual work with a clear point of view, shaping the details across whatever the project needs. The process stays flexible, but the goal is always the same: make the work feel cohesive, intentional, and complete.

steps.label: Delivery
steps.body: The final work is refined, organized, and prepared for real use. Whether it lives online, in motion, in print, or across a launch, the handoff is built to be clear, useful, and ready to move.

about.title: Strong creative direction, *rendered honestly.*
about.body:
I'm a Milwaukee-based designer and art director. I help brands bring their products, ideas, and stories to life through 3D product visualization and motion design, guided by strong creative direction and brand thinking.

My journey started young. I was rarely seen without a sketchbook in hand. Movies, music, video games, skateboarding… everything I loved became fuel for the art I created. My obsession with creating something out of nothing is what still drives me today.

When I pursued graphic design professionally, a lightbulb went off. I realized my creativity could serve a purpose beyond expression, which pushed me to explore every tool available.

The discovery of 3D design and animation became the turning point. It opened up limitless ways to translate ideas into photoreal product visuals and motion. Through this process, I combine storytelling, design, and precision into a single craft, transforming brand identity and packaging into fully realized 3D product visuals with clarity and intent.

Today, I channel that experience into helping brands stand out through 3D product visualization, creative direction, and motion design that feels intentional, elevated, and built to connect with their audience.

items.title: Product Animation
items.desc: Hero renders, campaign visuals, launch films, product motion, and photoreal CGI for brands that need their products to feel polished and premium.

items.title: Product Stills
items.desc: High-quality still imagery for websites, ads, packaging, social, retail pages, and launch campaigns.

items.title: Brand & Packaging Design
items.desc: Visual identity, packaging direction, label systems, mockups, and brand assets that help products feel more complete and refined.

items.title: Creative Direction & Consulting
items.desc: Early-stage direction, visual strategy, art direction, and creative support for brands that need help shaping how something should look and feel.
